sourceCorrections.rationale: The exact official IGN/INSEE label “Centre” is a human-readable local sector name retained after exact-ID Guide Alpha review. No safer licensed official 1:1 polygon crosswalk supports replacing it, so no neighborhood is invented.

An official IGN BD TOPO inhabited-place geometry contains the cited coordinate strictly inside exact IRIS 493310104. The unique 1:1 human label uses that contained toponym; no nearest-point assignment, polygon edit, merge or dropped cell is used.
